[C#m]  [A]

[Verse 1]
[C#m]Come on skinny love [A]just last the
[E]year, [B6/E]
[C#m]Pour a little salt [A]we're never
[E]here, [B6/E]My my my,
[C#m]my my my, [A]mymymy my-
[E]my... Staring at the
[F#m]sink of blood and crushed veneer.
[C#m]

[Verse 2]
[C#m]I tell my love [A]to wreck it
[E]all, [B6/E]
[C#m]Cut out all the ropes [A]and let me fall,
[E][B6/E]My my my,
[C#m]my my my, [A]mymymy mymy...
[E]Right in the
[F#m]moment this order's tall.
[C#m]And I

[Chorus]
[E]told you to be patient, And I
[B6/E]told you to be fine, [C#m]And I
[E]told you to be balanced, And I
[B6/E]told you to be kind, [C#m]And in the
[E]morning I'll be with you, But it will
[B6/E]be a different kind, [C#m]'Cause I'll be
[E]holding all the tickets, And you'll be
[B6/E]owning all the fines. [C#m]

[Verse 3]
[C#m]Come on skinny love, [A]what happened
[E]here? [B6/E]
[C#m]Suckle on the hope [A]in light brassieres,
[E][B6/E]My my my,
[C#m]my my my, [A]mymymy my-
[E]my... Sullen
[F#m]load is full, so slow on the split.
[C#m]And I

[Chorus]
[E]told you to be patient, And I
[B6/E]told you to be fine, [C#m]And I
[E]told you to be balanced, And I
[B6/E]told you to be kind, [C#m]And now
[E]all your love is wasted, And then
[B6/E]who the hell was I? [C#m]'Cause now I'm
[E]breaking at the britches, And at the
[B6/E]end of all your lines. [C#m]

[Bridge]
[E]Who will love you?
[B6/E]Who will [C#m]fight?
[E]And who will fall
[B6/E]far [C#m]behind?

[Outro]
[C#m]Come on skinny [A]love,
